people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Arnon
people.line: A river and valley, serving as a boundary for Israel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jabbok
people.line: A river east of the Jordan, associated with Jacob

translations.web: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was fortified.
translations.bsb: And Israel put him to the sword and took possession of his land, from the Arnon to the Jabbok—but only up to the border of the Ammonites, because it was fortified.
translations.kjv: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
translations.asv: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon unto the Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
